title: Ada and the Drop
author: Emrys Joubert
blurb: Odile Okonkwo, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
